cifar100_hierarchical_classification.description: CIFAR-100 hierarchical classification reported in Table 2 and Table 4 using the paper's 5-level CIFAR hierarchy.

accuracy.description: Fine-label top-1 accuracy, preserving the paper's no-loss-in-recognition constraint.

macro_accuracy.description: Class-balanced fine-label accuracy that catches improvements concentrated in only a subset of CIFAR-100 classes.

top5_accuracy.description: Fine-label top-5 accuracy to check that ranked predictions keep the true class near the top.

coarse_accuracy.description: Superclass accuracy that checks whether predictions remain useful at the coarser hierarchy level.

fine_coarse_consistency.description: Agreement between the predicted fine class's parent and an explicit submitted coarse prediction; missing coarse predictions receive zero.

ms.description: Average hierarchy distance among mistakes, retained as a severity constraint.

ahd@1.description: Average hierarchy distance of the top prediction over all examples.

ahd@5.description: Permutation-invariant top-5 hierarchy distance used as a complementary severity check.

ahd@20.description: Permutation-invariant top-20 hierarchy distance used as a broad ranked-list severity check.

hops.description: Paper's headline hierarchy-aware ranking metric over the full class order.

hops@5.description: Hierarchy-aware preference score restricted to the top five ranked classes.

hops@20.description: Hierarchy-aware preference score restricted to the top twenty ranked classes.

fpa.description: Full-path accuracy measuring simultaneous correctness across hierarchy levels.
